decisions.reason: The ETH mint Requirement already records ETH as its supported wallet payment asset. Enabling ETH in the separate customer-facing payment selector does not change the ETH mint flow itself.
The accepted change enables ETH and USDC wallet payment options. It does not change the deferred Transak fiat flow, its provider, fiat methods, conversion asset, or wallet provisioning behavior.
The USDC mint Requirement already records USDC as its payment asset and remains valid unchanged. Adding ETH alongside USDC in the payment selector does not alter the USDC mint behavior.
The source decision concerns selection between ETH and USDC wallet payments, not the optional gratuity, its presets, custom amount, or placement.
Enabling ETH and USDC payment choices does not change the mint price, affiliate commission, founder share, or prize-pool allocation.
The payment-selector change does not alter the NFT ebook format or unlimited edition supply.
The accepted payment-selector change does not explicitly require any FAQ copy revision, and propagating new disclosure text would require an additional content decision.
The source decision does not change the About page's approved topics, prize copy, or other displayed content.
Choosing between ETH and USDC wallet payments does not change email-link authentication or fiat-buyer dashboard access.
The wallet payment options do not affect the flat secondary royalty, ERC-721C standard, Creator Controls, or marketplace policy.
The source decision does not change the commission amount, allocation trigger, or recipient selection used when a referral is missing or rejected.
Adding ETH and USDC as selectable wallet payment options does not modify the SIWE protocol, authenticated user paths, or protected flows.
